milestone.title: Release-blocker sweep — B-42 sort regression + B-44 lifecycle gates + B-43 raul mp resolution
milestone.block_reason: Completion gated by M106 testing milestone: crates/mp/src/ac_verify.rs::execute pipe-buffer deadlock blocks mp milestone complete's gate. M106 fixes the verifier (std::thread reader drain) and is the upstream dep so M104's completion becomes possible. M104 work product is functionally shipped (7 steps done, 4 ACs passed, mp validate 0/0); only the completion record is deferred.

intent.outcome: After this milestone, the rc release candidate is safe to cut: lane/path output orders milestones correctly at 100+, the lifecycle migration is safe to run (gates still fire after legacy fields are cleared), and raul resolves the dev mp correctly so the new features are testable without make install.

problem.description: Three findings block a clean rc release of the M100-M103 foundation. (1) B-42: lexicographic sort at 8 sites puts milestone ids >= 100 between 10 and 11 — visible in mp list steps and mp path --all, the very feature M102 ships. (2) B-44: validate/plan.rs reads legacy spec_status/execution_status directly in several gates; once the bulk lifecycle migration runs and clears those fields, those gates become dead branches and silently stop firing. The migration utility is already shipped and callable, so this is a loaded footgun. (3) B-43: raul's find_mp prefers the installed mp via PATH even when MP_HOME is unset, so the new raul path --all fails against the stale global binary — the documented workaround is incomplete. None are caught by the current suite because the dogfood plan hasn't been migrated and only 4 milestones are >= 100.

in_scope: B-42: replace string .cmp() with paths::compare_milestone_ids at all 8 confirmed sites (commands/list.rs:203, reviews.rs:112/148/149, plan_diff.rs:170/176/345/406/447). Optionally fix the root: list_milestone_paths and list_archived_milestones sort numerically at the source so downstream callers can't forget.
B-44: re-express G1-G14 gate reads to use m.effective_lifecycle() consistently; add a regression test that migrates a fixture and runs validate to confirm gates still fire post-migration.

B-43: make raul's find_mp prefer a sibling target/release/mp when raul itself runs from target/ (dev mode Just Works), OR document the PATH requirement in master-plan/AGENTS.md. Structural fix preferred.
Regression test fixture with ids 99, 100, 101 asserting every list/path/diff/reviews output is numerically ordered.
out_of_scope: TUI tab-bar overflow hit-test (B-39, deferred to TUI milestone)
sidebar_focused rename (B-40, deferred to lifecycle restructure)
Finding.confidence enum validation (B-45/F-4, no CLI surface yet)
Bulk migration application to the 102 dogfood milestones (separate commit, after B-44 lands)

acceptance_criteria.description: mp list steps, mp list milestones, mp reviews list, mp plan diff, and mp path --all all order milestone ids numerically; a fixture with ids 99/100/101 returns them in that order, not 100/101/99.

After running migrate_plan_lifecycle on a fixture with gates-relevant milestones (draft/ready/in-progress/done/verified), mp validate still fires the same set of gate errors/warnings as before migration — no gate silently goes dead.
raul path --all works against the dev mp without make install: running raul from target/release resolves target/release/mp (or the repo's built binary) over the globally-installed stale one.
cargo test --workspace is green (0 failures) and mp validate on the dogfood plan is 0/0.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo test -p mp -p raul > /dev/null 2>&1 && mp validate --summary

design_decisions.choice: Fix at the source (list_milestone_paths / list_archived_milestones sort numerically) AND at the consumer sites, rather than only the consumers.
design_decisions.rationale: Source fix prevents the bug from recurring when a new caller forgets to re-sort. Consumer fixes are kept because some callers mix milestone and non-milestone ids in the same sort (e.g. list steps sorts by milestone then step), so they need explicit comparators anyway.

design_decisions.choice: Re-express only the gates that currently read spec_status/execution_status directly (G1, G5, G7, G8 read sites in validate/plan.rs). Do NOT add new lifecycle-only gates.
design_decisions.rationale: The goal is parity (gates fire the same before and after migration), not new enforcement. New lifecycle-driven transitions are M100's deferred AC-01..AC-06 and stay deferred.

design_decisions.choice: Structural fix: find_mp checks for a sibling target/release/mp next to the running raul binary first, before MP_HOME or PATH.
design_decisions.rationale: Makes dev mode Just Work without documenting env gymnastics. The check is cheap (one path existence test) and only fires in dev layouts — installed raul won't have a target/ sibling.

open_questions.question: Should the source-level numeric sort in list_milestone_paths use milestone_sort_key (Vec<u32>, handles dotted ids like 100.1) or a simpler u32 parse?
open_questions.answer: Use milestone_sort_key for consistency with compare_milestone_ids. It already handles dotted sub-step ids and is exported from paths.rs. A simpler u32 parse would diverge from the comparator used at consumer sites.

work_packages.name: B-42 sort regression
work_packages.goal: Replace lexicographic milestone id sorting with numeric ordering at all affected consumer sites and at the source list functions.
work_packages.rollback: Revert comparator changes in commands/list.rs, reviews.rs, plan_diff.rs, and paths.rs.

work_packages.name: B-44 lifecycle gates
work_packages.goal: Re-express validation gates G1, G5, G7, G8 to read effective_lifecycle() so they keep firing after legacy spec_status/execution_status fields are cleared by migration.
work_packages.rollback: Restore direct spec_status/execution_status reads in validate/plan.rs.

work_packages.name: Verification & closure
work_packages.goal: Run the full workspace test suite and validate the dogfood plan.
work_packages.rollback: Fix failing tests or validation errors before merging.

work_packages.name: B-43 raul mp resolution
work_packages.goal: Make raul resolve a sibling target/release/mp binary first when raul itself runs from a target/release build, so dev mode works without PATH or MP_HOME gymnastics.
work_packages.rollback: Revert find_mp precedence to PATH/MP_HOME before sibling check.

steps.action: Replace lexicographic .cmp() with paths::compare_milestone_ids at every milestone-id sort site in commands/list.rs, reviews.rs, plan_diff.rs, and path_engine.rs.
steps.done_when: All lex-id milestone-id sort sites use compare_milestone_ids and cargo test -p mp passes with no regressions.

steps.action: Fix source-level numeric sorting in list_milestone_paths and list_archived_milestones so downstream callers cannot forget.
steps.done_when: Source list functions return milestone ids in numeric order.

steps.action: Add a regression fixture with milestone ids 99, 100, 101 and assert all list/path/diff/reviews outputs order them numerically.
steps.done_when: Fixture exists and assertions pass for every identified output surface.

steps.action: Re-express validation gates G1, G5, G7, G8 in validate/plan.rs and gates.rs to read through a helper that derives spec_status/execution_status from effective_lifecycle() when legacy fields are empty, so gates fire the same before and after migration.
steps.done_when: All legacy-field reads in validate/plan.rs and check_gate_g1 route through the new helper; existing mp validate tests and gate fixtures fire the same gate set as before migration.

steps.action: Add a regression test that runs migrate_plan_lifecycle on a gates-relevant fixture and confirms validate fires the same gates post-migration.
steps.done_when: Test migrates fixture and asserts unchanged gate output.

steps.action: Make raul find_mp prefer a sibling target/release/mp next to the running raul binary before falling back to PATH or MP_HOME.
steps.done_when: raul path --all works from target/release without a global install.

steps.action: Run the full workspace test suite and validate the dogfood plan.
steps.tests: cargo test -p mp -p raul && mp validate --summary
steps.done_when: cargo test --workspace exits 0 and mp validate reports 0/0.
